'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Robbie Hendon LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robbie Hendon]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robbie Hendon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014806/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
